test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. 

(A) I must tell you that I am referring to the tax year which began on 1 April

(B) Let me be the first to wish you a very happy New Year

(C) In case none of your friends or family did so

(D) Now, before you ask whether the spring sunshine has gone to my head
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **CBDA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph begins with a friendly greeting, "Let me be the first to wish you a very happy New Year," which is appropriate for starting the message, as indicated by **part (C)**.
 
• Following the greeting, **part (B)** sets the context with a rhetorical question about the spring sunshine, preparing the reader for a light-hearted discussion.
 
• **Part (D)** explains what the speaker intends to talk about, specifically the tax year beginning on 1 April, providing clarity about the subject of the message.
 
• **Part (A)** concludes by confirming that the speaker is indeed referring to the current tax year, tying together the previous points and giving the final context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **CBDA.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (DBAC):** This sequence places the discussion about the tax year too early in the paragraph, disrupting the natural flow of greeting and context setting.
 
• **Option 3 (ADCB):** This option starts with an explanation of the tax year and lacks a warm, personal introduction that is essential for engagement.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This sequence begins with the explanation of the tax year, which is out of place before the greeting and contextual setup.
